name: urban_agri_skills
description: Interactive agent skills for UrbanAgri-Copilot: garden planning, plant diagnosis, organic remedy synthesis, and grocery-savings estimation.

tools.name: skill_plan_garden
tools.description: Generate a ranked crop plan for a location, container type, and available growing space using Open-Meteo weather forecasts and per-crop agronomic rules.

space_sqm.description: Available growing area in square metres.

target_month.description: Target calendar month (1-12) for the plan.

tools.name: skill_diagnose_plant
tools.description: Diagnose a plant health issue from an image. Uses a built-in mock expert unless a real vision endpoint is configured.

image_path.description: Filesystem path to the plant image to analyse.

crop_name.description: Optional crop name to guide the diagnosis.

tools.name: skill_synthesize_remedy
tools.description: Generate a zero-chemical organic remedy recipe from kitchen scraps for a given plant issue.

issue_type.description: Plant issue or deficiency to treat, e.g. 'Nitrogen Deficiency'.

available_scraps.description: Optional list of kitchen scraps available at home.

tools.name: skill_calculate_savings
tools.description: Estimate household grocery savings for growing a crop based on current retail market prices.

crop_name.description: Name of the crop to evaluate.
